Tamil Nadu Political Developments: Alliance Meeting and Alleged Poaching Plot

Tamil Nadu's ruling TVK party and its post-poll allies held a meeting to institutionalize their alliance, discussing a common minimum program. Concurrently, allegations of a plot to poach MLAs have surfaced, leading to arrests and a political dispute between the TVK and DMK. The Chief Minister has also expressed opposition to the Viksit Bharat Guarantee scheme, citing financial concerns.
